sensitivity_label_enforcement.title: Sensitivity Label Enforcement
sensitivity_label_enforcement.description: Whether sensitivity/classification labels are enforced on SIEM incident records at the platform level, versus optional or absent

incident_export_controls_enabled.title: Incident Export/Sharing Controls Enabled
incident_export_controls_enabled.description: Whether the SIEM enforces access controls or approval workflows that prevent analysts from freely exporting, forwarding, or sharing incident reports externally

incident_access_role_restriction.title: Incident Record Access Role Restriction
incident_access_role_restriction.description: The scope of role-based access control applied to SIEM incident records — whether access is restricted to security personnel only, broadly available to operational staff, or unrestricted

incident_data_roles_with_access.title: Roles With Access to Raw Incident Data
incident_data_roles_with_access.description: List of roles beyond the security team that have read or write access to raw SIEM incident data, including full incident records, IOCs, and analyst findings

need_to_know_justification_enforced.title: Need-to-Know Justification Enforced for Incident Data Access
need_to_know_justification_enforced.description: Whether a documented need-to-know justification process is enforced before granting any role access to raw SIEM incident data

incident_data_access_scope.title: Scope of Incident Data Accessible to Broad Roles
incident_data_access_scope.description: The scope of incident data that non-security roles can access — full raw records (including IOCs, victim details, TTPs), summary/redacted views only, or no access

pii_masking_enforced.title: PII Masking Enforced in Incident Records
pii_masking_enforced.description: Whether the SIEM platform enforces automatic masking or pseudonymization of PII fields (user identities, IP addresses, email addresses, device identifiers) before writing incident tickets or logs to storage

pii_field_types_stored_plaintext.title: PII Field Types Stored in Plaintext
pii_field_types_stored_plaintext.description: List of PII field categories confirmed to be stored in plaintext within SIEM incident records (e.g., user_identity, ip_address, email_address, device_identifier)

retention_policy_defined.title: Formal Retention Policy Defined
retention_policy_defined.description: Indicates whether a formal, documented retention schedule exists specifically for SIEM-derived incident records, covering minimum and maximum retention periods

retention_period_days.title: Defined Retention Period (Days)
retention_period_days.description: The maximum number of days SIEM incident records are retained before scheduled disposal, as specified in policy. A value of 0 indicates no upper bound is defined (indefinite retention).

legal_hold_integration_configured.title: Legal Hold Integration Configured
legal_hold_integration_configured.description: Indicates whether the SIEM or associated data store has a mechanism to apply legal holds that pause automated deletion of incident records when litigation or regulatory investigation requires preservation

encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Encryption at Rest Enabled
encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Whether encryption at rest is enforced on the storage system hosting incident data (shared drives, ticketing systems, SIEM export repositories)

incident_data_storage_location_type.title: Incident Data Storage Location Type
incident_data_storage_location_type.description: The type of repository where incident summaries, analyst notes, and SIEM exports are stored

access_control_enforced.title: Access Controls Enforced on Incident Repository
access_control_enforced.description: Whether role-based or need-to-know access controls are actively enforced on the repository storing incident data, limiting access to authorized personnel only

incident_data_contains_pii_from_regulate.title: Incident Data Contains PII from Regulated Jurisdiction
incident_data_contains_pii_from_regulate.description: Indicates whether SIEM incident records include personally identifiable information belonging to data subjects from regulated jurisdictions (e.g., EU residents under GDPR, UK residents under UK GDPR)

cross_border_transfer_destinations.title: Cross-Border Transfer Destination Countries
cross_border_transfer_destinations.description: List of countries or regions to which SIEM incident data (including raw logs, IOC context, analyst notes) is transferred, such as MSSP SOC locations or foreign cloud storage regions

data_transfer_legal_basis_documented.title: Data Transfer Legal Basis Documented
data_transfer_legal_basis_documented.description: Indicates whether a documented legal basis for the cross-border transfer exists, such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), adequacy decision, Binding Corporate Rules, or equivalent mechanism required under the applicable data protection regulation

pii_anonymization_applied_before_transfe.title: PII Anonymization Applied Before Transfer
pii_anonymization_applied_before_transfe.description: Indicates whether PII fields within incident data are anonymized or pseudonymized in a manner that prevents re-identification before the data is transferred cross-border

certified_destruction_procedure_enforced.title: Certified Destruction Procedure Enforced
certified_destruction_procedure_enforced.description: Indicates whether a formal, certified destruction or secure deletion procedure is mandated and enforced for closed incident records, covering all storage locations including primary systems, backups, and exports

residual_data_locations_addressed.title: Residual Data Locations Addressed
residual_data_locations_addressed.description: Indicates whether disposal procedures explicitly cover all residual data locations such as recycle bins, backup snapshots, unmanaged exports, and shared drive copies to prevent recoverable remnants of closed incident records

incident_record_retention_policy_status.title: Incident Record Retention Policy Status
incident_record_retention_policy_status.description: The current status of the organization's documented retention and disposal policy specifically governing closed SIEM incident records
